cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow my ladder for two lifts to the station. Two separate journeys; we should define that now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need the ladder for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Duration affects the rate, not whether there is one. One lift, and you return it dry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll give you five pounds. We're friends; can we keep it simple?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Four pounds if you say we're good friends. Please specify that before I hand it over.

reason: Use exacting terms and definitions to make A negotiate both the practical loan and B offered friendship rather than merely announce professionalism.
